review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: This is a hands-on Subject Matter Expert (SME) role, working across security engineering, network architecture, automation, operations, and security governance. Strong experience as a Senior Network & Security Engineer Hands-on expertise with Palo Alto, Panorama, F5 BIG-IP, and Cisco Strong knowledge of network security and enterprise infrastructure Experience with TLS/SSL inspection and Advanced Threat Protection Solid automation skills using Python and Ansible Experience with APIs, Git, YAML, IaC, and CI/CD Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities Experience with security governance and compliance Ability to work across architecture, engineering, operations, and security Experience within banking or financial services is a strong advantage.
